description: This file defines the ViewDetail class, which is responsible for rendering the detailed view of a record in the SuiteCRM application. It extends the SugarView class, includes setting up a DetailView2 object, and handles display logic for a record detail page.

classes.name: ViewDetail
classes.description: A class for handling the detailed view in SuiteCRM, extending the SugarView base class, and integrating DetailView2 to display record details.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Initializes the DetailView2 object, sets it up with the module, bean, metadata file, and template for rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the detailed view for a record, verifying the presence of a record ID and invoking process and display methods on the DetailView2 object.
